narrative: An afternoon stage, a chair set where Gaunt dies, and the tiring-house door open behind it so the rest of the play is still in the same house. No one is leaving by the street door.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played Gaunt and did not leave early.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Kept the king through the afternoon.

entities.name: Gaunt
entities.context: Shown on stage in Still in the house
